name: SEBI Grade A Officer Practice Mock - Practice Test 1
courseName: SEBI Grade A Officer Practice Mock

questions.question: Who is the current regulator of the securities market in India?
questions.hint: SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) regulates the securities market in India.

questions.question: What does "IPO" stand for in financial markets?
questions.hint: IPO stands for Initial Public Offering, which is when a company first sells shares to the public.

questions.question: What is the primary function of a commercial bank?
questions.hint: Commercial banks accept deposits from the public and use them to extend loans.

questions.question: Inflation in India is primarily measured by which index?
questions.hint: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) is the primary measure of inflation in India.

questions.question: What is the full form of GDP?
questions.hint: GDP stands for Gross Domestic Product.

questions.question: Which government authority formulates the Fiscal Policy in India?
options: Securities and Exchange Board of India
questions.hint: The Ministry of Finance formulates the Fiscal Policy of the country.

questions.question: What does SLR stand for in banking terms?
questions.hint: SLR stands for Statutory Liquidity Ratio, a minimum percentage of deposits banks must keep in liquid assets.

questions.question: Which was the first development financial institution established in India?
questions.hint: IFCI (Industrial Finance Corporation of India) was established in 1948.

questions.question: Treasury Bills (T-Bills) in India are issued by whom?
questions.hint: The RBI issues T-bills on behalf of the Central Government to meet short-term funding needs.

questions.question: Where is the head office of SEBI located?
questions.hint: The head office of SEBI is located at Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) in Mumbai.

questions.question: What is the full form of FDI?
questions.hint: FDI stands for Foreign Direct Investment.

questions.question: Which act replaced the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act (FERA) in India?
questions.hint: FEMA (Foreign Exchange Management Act) replaced FERA in 1999.

questions.question: Which of the following is the central bank of India?
questions.hint: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is India's central banking institution.

questions.question: The Financial Year in India runs from:
questions.hint: The Indian financial year begins on April 1 and ends on March 31 of the next calendar year.

questions.question: In which year was the Goods and Services Tax (GST) implemented in India?
questions.hint: GST was implemented in India on July 1, 2017.
